stories.headline: Israel election yields no majority: Netanyahu bloc at 53 seats, Arab parties hit record 19

key_facts.fact: With 85.6% of votes counted on Oct. 28, the Central Elections Committee gave Netanyahu's bloc 53 seats and Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar-led bloc 48, with 61 seats needed for a majority.
key_facts.excerpt: The Central Elections Committee announces 53 seats for the bloc led by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and 48 seats for the bloc led by Yashar leader Gadi Eisenkot. The Arab parties have 19 seats, a historic high. At least 61 seats are required for a majority.

key_facts.fact: Arab parties reached 19 seats, a historic high, with the Joint List at 12 and Ra'am at 7.
key_facts.excerpt: The latest results by the CEC put 19 seats in the Arab parties, with the Joint List having 12 seats and Ra'am having seven seats in the next Knesset.

key_facts.fact: Likud is projected at 26 seats and Eisenkot's Yashar at 21; Bennett and Lapid's B'Yachad has 12, Golan's Democrats 8 and Liberman's Yisrael Beytenu 7.
key_facts.excerpt: Netanyahu's Likud is projected to enter with 26 seats... Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar is projected to enter the Knesset with 21 seats. B'Yachad, led by Naftali Bennett and Yair Lapid, is expected to enter with 12 seats.

key_facts.fact: About 500,000-600,000 double-envelope ballots, including soldiers' votes, remain to be counted over the next couple of days.
key_facts.excerpt: some 600,000 so-called double envelope votes have yet to be counted. These are expected to be added to the tally in the next couple of days.

key_facts.fact: President Isaac Herzog urged parties to avoid another election and said he would begin consultations next week on granting the mandate to form a government.
key_facts.excerpt: Herzog said he would begin consultations next week on granting the mandate to form a government, adding that he expected party leaders to "come with an open mind."

key_facts.fact: Neither Netanyahu nor Eisenkot was projected to win a majority, setting the stage for weeks of coalition negotiations.
key_facts.excerpt: Neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nor his main challenger, Gadi Eisenkot, were projected to gain a parliamentary majority. The close race set the stage for weeks of negotiations over the next government.

key_facts.fact: Joint List leader Ahmad Tibi said the Eisenkot-led opposition could unseat Netanyahu by forming a government with the Arab parties "if it is brave enough to."
key_facts.excerpt: Tibi said the bloc could form a government "if it wants to, if it is brave enough to."

stories.headline: Gulf states draft Hormuz peace plan as Houthis claim strike on Saudi Ras Tanura refinery

key_facts.fact: Gulf states are working on a multipart deal under which Iran would reopen the Strait of Hormuz within four days of sanctions being lifted and the Houthis would withdraw substantial forces inside Yemen.
key_facts.excerpt: A multipronged peace deal to reopen the strait of Hormuz within four days of sanctions being lifted and for the Houthis to withdraw substantial forces inside Yemen are at the heart of Gulf states' plans to avert what they regard as a disastrous renewal of war between Iran and the US.

key_facts.fact: The US is holding out for a further concession that European powers suggest could be Iran readmitting UN weapons inspectors, which Iran has so far refused.
key_facts.excerpt: The US is aware of the talks' progress but is holding out for a concession that European powers suggest could involve Iran allowing UN weapons inspectors back into the country.

key_facts.fact: The Houthis said on Tuesday (Oct. 27) they had struck Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery, the kingdom's biggest, with a ballistic missile.
key_facts.excerpt: The Houthis said on Tuesday that they had struck Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura oil refinery, the biggest in the kingdom, with a ballistic missile.

key_facts.fact: Brent crude settled down $1.93 (1.67%) at $113.88 a barrel on Oct. 27 and WTI fell $1.86 to $99.90, on diplomacy hopes.
key_facts.excerpt: Brent crude futures settled down $1.93, or 1.67%, at $113.88 a barrel. US West Texas Intermediate crude settled down $1.86, or 1.83%, at $99.90.

key_facts.fact: Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei met security chief Mohsen Rezaei on Oct. 27 and said the state of 'neither war nor peace' must end, while stressing control over the Strait of Hormuz.
key_facts.excerpt: Khamenei said the current state of "neither war nor peace" needs to end... He discussed "safeguarding national and regional security by maintaining control" over the Strait of Hormuz.

key_facts.fact: Qatar on Oct. 27 urged Iran to 'show goodwill' by ending threats to the region and reopening the strait; crude flows through Hormuz were around 60% of normal per ANZ.
key_facts.excerpt: Qatar urged Iran on Tuesday to "show goodwill" by stopping threats against countries in the region and reopening the Strait of Hormuz... Crude flows through Hormuz were around 60% of normal, according to ANZ research.

key_facts.fact: UBS raised its forecast and expects Brent to stay near $110 a barrel through year-end, up from $100.
key_facts.excerpt: UBS said it expects Brent prices to stay elevated near $110 a barrel through the end of the year, an increase from its previous forecast for $100 a barrel at the end of the year.

stories.headline: Zelensky says Ukraine is retaking ground, reveals pipeline 'Veles' operation; Oleshky truce holds

key_facts.fact: Zelensky said Ukrainian forces are retaking territory through a series of offensives and that Kyiv's battlefield position is the strongest it has been in some time.
key_facts.excerpt: Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said Ukrainian forces are retaking territory through a series of offensives, adding Kyiv's battlefield position was the strongest it had been in some time.

key_facts.fact: Zelensky disclosed the previously secret Operation Veles, in which Ukrainian troops used underground gas pipelines to outflank Russian positions near Kupiansk.
key_facts.excerpt: Zelensky revealed details of the previously secret Operation Veles, where Ukrainian troops used underground gas pipelines to outflank Russian positions near Kupiansk in the northeast.

key_facts.fact: He also cited an air assault operation in eastern Ukraine and Operation 'Vivaldi' further north, aimed at preventing Russian advances.
key_facts.excerpt: He also referred to an air assault operation in eastern Ukraine and the "Vivaldi" operation further to the north, designed to prevent Russian advances in key areas.

key_facts.fact: Ukraine's human rights ombudsman said the first 30 hours of the Oleshky ceasefire, which runs until Nov. 1 to allow evacuations and aid, passed without a single incident.
key_facts.excerpt: Human Rights Ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets said on Oct. 28 that the first 30 hours of the ceasefire in the town of Oleshky had passed "without a single incident"... set to last until Nov. 1

key_facts.fact: Elsewhere, Russia launched a ballistic missile and 88 Shahed-type drones overnight on Oct. 28; Ukraine intercepted 71 drones, and Russian strikes killed 2 and injured 17 over the past day.
key_facts.excerpt: Russian forces launched an Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missile and 88 Shahed-type drones at Ukraine, including 38 jet-powered drones, overnight on Oct. 28... Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 71 drones

key_facts.fact: The Kremlin showed no sign of softening during the Nordic leaders' call, insisting any lasting peace must 'unconditionally' take Russia's interests into account.
key_facts.excerpt: The Kremlin showed no indication of any softening in its position during the call, insisting that any lasting peace must "unconditionally" take Russia's interests into account.

stories.headline: Jio Platforms jumps 21% in debut after India's record $3.2B IPO, becomes No. 2 listed firm

key_facts.fact: Jio Platforms listed on the NSE and BSE on Oct. 28 at ₹1,358 per share, a 21.36% premium to its ₹1,119 issue price.
key_facts.excerpt: The ₹30,200 crore ($3.2 billion) IPO was listed on the exchanges at ₹1,358 per share, a premium of 21.36% compared to the issue price of ₹1,119.

key_facts.fact: The $3.2 billion offering is India's largest-ever IPO and was subscribed more than 22 times, with the institutional portion subscribed 70.55 times.
key_facts.excerpt: raising 302 billion rupees ($3.2 billion) in the country's largest-ever IPO. The public issue was subscribed more than 22 times... The qualified institutional portion was subscribed 70.55 times

key_facts.fact: Shares rose as much as 27.3% and closed at ₹1,417.5, valuing Jio at about $137 billion and making it India's second-largest company after parent Reliance Industries, ahead of Bharti Airtel and HDFC Bank.
key_facts.excerpt: Jio's stock ended the trading day at 1,417.5 rupees... It rose as much as 27.3% during trade, and its market capitalisation overtook those of telecom firm Bharti Airtel and HDFC Bank

key_facts.fact: The debut came even as the Sensex and Nifty each fell about 1%.
key_facts.excerpt: The stock made a strong debut despite weakness in the broader market, with the benchmark Sensex and Nifty falling by 1% each.

key_facts.fact: The IPO was entirely fresh shares; neither Reliance nor strategic investors Meta and Google sold stock, and it drew 1.38 crore (13.8 million) applications, a record.
key_facts.excerpt: the Jio Platforms IPO did not involve a share sale by parent Reliance Industries or strategic investors Meta and Google.

key_facts.fact: Jio plans to use up to $2.89 billion of net proceeds to repay borrowings of its telecom unit.
key_facts.excerpt: Jio plans to use up to $2.89 billion of the net IPO proceeds to repay the borrowings of its telecoms unit.

stories.headline: FCC approves Amazon Leo's $11.5B Globalstar buy, opening its direct-to-phone satellite push

key_facts.fact: The FCC approved Amazon Leo's acquisition of Globalstar on Oct. 27 (order DA-26-1160), saying it would expand direct-to-device competition, strengthen emergency communications and improve service in underserved areas.
key_facts.excerpt: Transaction will expand D2D competition, strengthen emergency communications, and improve service in unserved and underserved areas. DA/FCC #: DA-26-1160... Released On: Oct 27, 2026

key_facts.fact: The deal is valued at about $11.5 billion and includes roughly 25 MHz of internationally harmonized mobile-satellite spectrum.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon Leo has received Federal Communications Commission (FCC) approval as part of its $11.57 billion acquisition of Globalstar, which includes about 25 megahertz of internationally harmonized mobile-satellite spectrum.

key_facts.fact: Globalstar will become a wholly owned Amazon subsidiary operating as an affiliate of Kuiper Systems (Amazon Leo); Amazon gave no update on closing timing, previously expected in 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Globalstar will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Amazon. It will operate as an affiliate of Kuiper Systems LLC (the business now known as Amazon Leo)... When the deal was first announced, it was expected to close in 2027.

key_facts.fact: Amazon Leo also has a pending FCC application for a direct-to-device constellation of up to 5,105 satellites and plans a next-generation D2D platform in 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon Leo's grander ambitions include a plan to launch a next-gen D2D platform in 2028... The FCC is reviewing Amazon Leo's application to build a D2D system of more than 5,105 satellites.

key_facts.fact: Through the deal Amazon takes over Globalstar's agreement with Apple, which powers satellite services such as Emergency SOS on iPhone and Apple Watch.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon and Apple reached an agreement for Amazon Leo to power satellite services for iPhone and Apple Watch, including Emergency SOS via satellite.

key_facts.fact: The FCC dismissed the only opposing petition, from Yippy, a former Globalstar partner in a contractual dispute now in arbitration.
key_facts.excerpt: Only one entity filed against the acquisition. Yippy... The FCC dismissed Yippy's concerns because the dispute between the companies is in arbitration.

stories.headline: CFTC sues Utah to block its gambling case against Kalshi, its first suit against a GOP-led state

key_facts.fact: The CFTC announced on Oct. 27 that it filed a lawsuit against Utah to block the state's efforts to shut down CFTC-registered contract markets using state law.
key_facts.excerpt: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced today it has filed a lawsuit against Utah to block the state's efforts to shut down CFTC-registered contract markets using state laws.

key_facts.fact: CFTC Chairman Michael Selig said Congress entrusted the CFTC as the sole regulator of prediction markets and the agency will defend its exclusive jurisdiction.
key_facts.excerpt: "Congress entrusted the CFTC to be the federal regulator with sole responsibility to oversee these markets... the CFTC has the expertise and responsibility to defend its exclusive jurisdiction over commodity derivatives"

key_facts.fact: The suit responds to Utah Attorney General Derek Brown's Oct. 20 state-court enforcement action against Kalshi and Susquehanna entities, alleging illegal gambling.
key_facts.excerpt: On October 20, 2026, the State of Utah, through its Attorney General Derek Brown... filed an enforcement action... against Kalshi, Inc. and KalshiEX LLC... Susquehanna International Group LLP

key_facts.fact: It is the CFTC's 10th lawsuit against a state over prediction markets and its first against a state led by a Republican governor.
key_facts.excerpt: It marks the CFTC's 10th such lawsuit against a state seeking to rein in the prediction markets — and its first against a state led by a Republican governor.

key_facts.fact: The complaint argues Utah's gambling and public nuisance laws are preempted under the Supremacy Clause and seeks preliminary and permanent injunctions; the court has not ruled.
key_facts.excerpt: It contends Utah's gambling statutes and its public nuisance law are expressly, field and conflict preempted as applied to those contracts... The court has not ruled on any of the claims.

key_facts.fact: Gambling is constitutionally banned in Utah, and the state has so far prevailed against Kalshi in federal court.
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. agency that oversees derivatives has filed a federal legal challenge to halt Utah's attempt to stop prediction market betting in its state, where gambling is constitutionally banned... After Utah has so far prevailed against Kalshi in federal court

stories.headline: Ferring agrees to buy fertility biotech Gameto in a deal worth up to $1.38 billion

key_facts.fact: Ferring Pharmaceuticals and Gameto announced on Oct. 27 a signed agreement under which Ferring would acquire Gameto.
key_facts.excerpt: Ferring Pharmaceuticals and Gameto today announced that they have signed an agreement for a global transaction under which Ferring would acquire Gameto.

key_facts.fact: The deal is worth up to $1.3825 billion, subject to development, regulatory and commercial milestones.
key_facts.excerpt: The proposed transaction has a deal value of up to $1.3825 billion, subject to development, regulatory and commercial milestones.

key_facts.fact: Gameto uses cell engineering to develop treatments for women's reproductive health, starting with infertility; its In Vitro Maturation programme is investigational and not FDA-approved in the US.
key_facts.excerpt: Gameto is a biotechnology company using cell engineering to develop novel treatment solutions for women's reproductive health, starting with infertility... Gameto's In Vitro Maturation programme is investigational in the United States and has not been approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.

key_facts.fact: Ferring is a privately owned Swiss specialty biopharma group founded in 1950, headquartered in Saint-Prex, with subsidiaries in more than 50 countries.
key_facts.excerpt: Ferring Pharmaceuticals is a privately owned specialty biopharmaceutical group... Ferring was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Saint-Prex, Switzerland. The company has operating subsidiaries in more than 50 countries

key_facts.fact: Completion is subject to closing conditions; the companies operate independently until then. Gameto CEO Dina Turner called it 'a defining moment' for the company.
key_facts.excerpt: Completion remains subject to customary and other closing conditions. Until closing, the companies will continue to operate independently... "This is a defining moment for Gameto and for our mission to transform reproductive health"
